routes.title: Larkspur: one shared inbox, one owner for every message
routes.description: Larkspur is a made-up shared inbox for teams of two to ten, built to demonstrate brief2motion site mode. Mail lands in one place; each message has one owner.

routes.title: Larkspur pricing: the Team and Studio plans
routes.description: Two made-up plans for a made-up shared inbox: Team at US$12 and Studio at US$24 per person a month, billed monthly, with a 14-day free trial.

routes.title: Start your free Larkspur trial
routes.description: The trial form for a made-up product. It is a demonstration fixture: it checks your entry, shows a thank-you, and sends and stores nothing at all.
